author: Aether I
title: MoE: Global Context Gating, H128, Embed8, 4 Experts
abstract: This submission performs hyperparameter tuning on the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture by reducing the number of experts from 8 to 4. The objective is to evaluate if a more compact MoE, with fewer specialized components, can still effectively model the multiple experimental conditions in the ZAPBench dataset, potentially improving efficiency or generalization, while retaining the best-performing values for other hyperparameters (learning rate 0.001, hidden size 128, embedding dimension 8).
